## Setup Renv and Install Dependencies

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Clear active workspace memory at the start of interactive runs
# If prompted to load in the renv, select Option 1
rm(list = ls())

# Ensure 'here' is available and loaded so relative paths can be used
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("here", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
library(here)

# Force knitr to run all notebook chunks from the project root directory
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here())

# Set global Quarto / R Markdown chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,          # Show code chunks in final report
  warning = FALSE,      # Hide package execution warnings
  message = FALSE,      # Hide library load startup messages
  fig.width = 8,        # Standardize figure width
  fig.height = 5,       # Standardize figure height
  fig.align = "center"  # Center plot outputs
)

# Install and load all required project dependencies natively
source(here("code+nb/install_deps.R"))
```
